candidates.reason: This is just the original shrunk into the middle of the tall canvas, with no rearranging. The top 130px and bottom 130px are empty. The bullets, tagline and button label are tiny, and the legal line can't be read. The layout still reads as a wide design and doesn't suit the tall format.

It is properly rearranged for the tall shape: the headline wraps to two lines, the bullets stack in order and the product circle sits below them, with a readable hierarchy. But the left edges don't line up: the logo pill (x≈40), headline (x≈18), bullets (x≈40) and button (x≈40) each start somewhere different. The product circle is pushed right and leaves an empty patch on the left. The button, tagline and legal line are crammed into the bottom quarter with little space between them.

The three-line headline is so large it dominates. The first three bullets are a consistent size, but the 4th ('Fine bubbles…') shrinks to small type and is moved into a bottom-left corner away from the list, breaking it up. The tagline and legal text are squeezed into a narrow right column next to the button, and the legal text is unreadable. The product is shrunk to a small circle. Spacing at the bottom is crowded.

This has the same layout problems as candidate 4, and the type is less consistent.
